title: Worker
description: A worker record that P2 worker.enroll writes: tenant, role, kind, labels, and for a toolhost the plugins, placement and machine. A worker process serves one tenant (TEN-4). Liveness is last_seen at the core, not a worker self-report (STA-2). A worker record has no owner field: a personal assistant is a pool of workers, and the core writes the owner into the lease (DSP-10). Worker lifecycle: spec/lifecycles/worker.md.

labels.description: Labels recorded at enroll; hello may only narrow them.

host.description: Toolhost only: a machine from the tenant catalog.

target.description: Channel, sink or monitoring adapter: the name of the target the worker is recorded for; claim(delivery) hands out deliveries by it (TEN-3).

last_seen.description: Time of the last P1 call; any call updates it.

bot.description: The bot identity bound to the worker.
